packageRules.description: One weekly PR for everything that should not break anything.
Actions move together so the pinned SHAs stay reviewable in one place.
Majors stay separate; each needs its own look at the changelog.
next runs behind our own server, so custom server advisories apply to us. Keep it in its own PR, security reviewed, with no release age wait.
prBodyNotes: The dashboard is a custom server (the client IP wrapper). Treat any advisory that mentions custom servers as applying to us.
